logp.method_description: The partition coefficient (log P) of the Cu complexes and their respective ligands were determined using the traditional shake-flask method in n-octanol/water. The compounds were first dissolved in n-octanol, presaturated with water, and then water (presaturated with n-octanol) was added in 1:1 ratio. The samples were mixed for 2 h and afterwards the two phases were separated by centrifugation at 6000 rpm. UV–Vis spectra were then recorded for both phases and the final log P value was calculated using Equation (1): log P = [compound]octanol/[compound]water = log(Aoctanol/Awater)
